items.content_snippet: C. Thi Nguyen is a philosopher at the University of Utah, and before this he wrote a book called *Games: Agency as Art*, which argues that games are an art form whose medium is you. A game hands you a temporary self: crisp goals, clean scoring, a clear sense of whether you're doing well. That's the pleasure of it. items.title: AWS RTB Fabric now supports configurable Availability Zone affinity
items.content_snippet: AWS RTB Fabric now supports configurable Availability Zone (AZ) affinity for responder gateways. With this capability, you can configure how your partners connect to your responder gateway: either in their own Availability Zone or to any Availability Zone that the gateway spans. items.title: Amazon SNS now supports message payloads up to 1 MiB
items.content_snippet: Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) now supports message payloads up to 1 MiB, a 4x increase from the previous 256 KiB limit, so you can publish larger messages to your SNS topics. Amazon SNS is a fully managed pub/sub messaging service that enables you to decouple and scale microservices, distributed systems, and serverless applications.
